relationships.evidence_quote: Conversely, WBV reduced CGRP + structures in the dorsal horn, decreased the density of CGRP + perisomatic and axo-axonic synapses, and lowered astrocytic and microglial populations.

relationships.subject: whole-body vibration
relationships.evidence_quote: WBV increased the linear density of VGAT + and VGLUT1 + perisomatic terminals, as well as the number of SER + fibers

relationships.subject: whole-body vibration
relationships.evidence_quote: PAB was consistently reduced in WBV-treated animals.

key_findings: Whole-body vibration after rat thoracic SCI reduced pain-associated behavior and dorsal horn CGRP+ structures and synapses, and lowered astro- and microglial populations.
WBV increased VGAT+ and VGLUT1+ perisomatic terminals and serotonergic fibers.
